top_signals.title: SET Head: Lot of Interest From Firms to Raise Capital
top_signals.summary: The Stock Exchange of Thailand President Asadej Kongsiri says the bourse is seeing a lot of interest from firms to raise capital. He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'Thailand Focus 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: SoftBank Mulls Up to $20 Billion Bond Sale for OpenAI Financing
top_signals.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. is talking with investment banks about a potential $10 billion to $20 billion bond offering to help refinance a loan for its investment in US tech giant OpenAI, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Takaichi rejects ‘weak-kneed’ criticism over ICC sanctions response
top_signals.summary: Criticism mounted after Tokyo's initial response to the U.S. sanctioning International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane was to describe the move as "very unfortunate."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

Golf, events and bags of nostalgia at Newport’s Celtic Manor
top_signals.summary: There’s something very nostalgic about Celtic Manor. Located a few minutes down the M4 from Newport town centre, it manages to feel entirely remote, an imposing stone building nestled within some 2,000 acres of grounds.
